name: cautious-return-override
facts:
Goal: maximize wealth at the end of the plan (terminal wealth), planning to age 95.
- Age 45, single filer, retiring at 65.
- Gross income $120,000 a year; can save $20,000 a year.
- Will spend $70,000 a year in retirement.
- Balances: $300,000 traditional (pre-tax), $0 Roth, $150,000 taxable brokerage.
- Social Security: $28,000 a year starting at age 68. No pension, no employer match.
- Wants a conservative 4% expected real return instead of the default. Default assumptions are fine for everything else.
